description.value: Kuno Garden is a Japanese-style memorial garden in Richmond, BC, operated by the City of Richmond as a municipal green space. Situated near the Fraser River delta, it offers a quiet, contemplative stop reflecting Japanese landscape design traditions. Touring cyclists exploring Richmond's flat dyke trail network may find it a peaceful waypoint.
